set.EXPERIMENT_OS_ISSUE_COMMAND: {"command_id":"lo-fix-receiptvis-20260824b","action":"PROPOSE_FIX","actor":"cal","actor_role":"LIVE_OPS","schema_version":1,"payload":{"proposed_fix":"Place ONLY bounded, closed-vocabulary receipt metadata in the operator-visible MESSAGE, so the ops logs channel carries it even though it drops structured log_event fields. The permitted set is exactly: the receipt status (SUCCEEDED / REJECTED / FAILED / DEFERRED), the action name, the command identifier or a safe hash prefix of it, the receipt identifier, and a stable error CODE. Every one of those is drawn from a fixed vocabulary the code owns, not from anything a submitter supplied. NEVER include in the message: submitted payload values; unknown or unrecognised payload key names; raw exception text; SQL statements or their bound parameters; traceback content. That boundary is not a style preference - the transport is public and an exception quotes the offending value, the failing statement and its parameters, so an unbounded message would republish exactly what the receipt sanitizer already strips.
